$comment: Visual scenes for the 13 key-art records (home, mode cards, loading, store, portal). Pure picture description: no titles, quotes, numbers or UI copy. A value is the scene string, or {scene, roster}: roster lists the NAMED fighters (content ids, or id:skin) that appear; run_xai.py sends a board of their real models (ref_board.py) as the reference image, and the sensitivity sign-off (_design/reviews/fixwaves/W2_art_signoff.md) names every painted figure to one of these ids. Unnamed figures, crowds and armies are not allowed. build_keyart_prompts.py puts each in front of the record's fixed style, figure and sensitivity tail.

home_feature.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Ervet, a tall lean woman knight in a heavy layered blue-grey scale mantle over chalk-white armour, a full chalk-white helm with a slit glass visor marked by a pale blue cross, a long translucent pale-blue glass greatsword; Ardit, a broad square knight in chalk-white and pale-blue plate, a flat-topped square helm with a narrow pale-blue glass visor band, a tall clear glass pavise shield with blue diamond studs on his left arm, a short spear; Marund, a short stout mason in a felt apron and leather, a wide round ironstone dome cap, a carved walnut mask with a carved beard and narrow carved eye slits shaded under the cap brim, a heavy stone maul. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Wide cinematic key art of a fight, NOT a group portrait: on a broad carved pale-stone road across a colossal sundial valley at the long hour, Ervet lunges toward the right with her glass greatsword in a sweeping slash, Ardit braced a step behind her with his glass pavise raised, and Marund charges in from the right, facing them, his stone maul swinging up to meet her blade; bright shards of pale glass light and curling ink smoke burst where the weapons meet. Cool blue-white morning light from the left over tall pale chalk spires, warm amber evening light from the right over low dark ironstone domes. The left third of the frame is open road and soft calm shadow for interface text; the three fighters fill the right two thirds, large and readable.

home_tile_ranked_season.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Vashil, a tall straight figure in long chalk-pale robes and a soft low rounded hood, a floating chalk ring of seven small clear glass bells above his head, an arched glass visor, a long striking rod. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Painted card illustration: Vashil seen from behind at three-quarter view climbing a long flight of carved chalk steps toward a pale stone bell tower on a bright sunlit summit, his ring of glass bells catching the light, the light growing stronger with every step, a feeling of ascent and earned rank. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

home_tile_almanac_teaser: Painted card illustration: a great closed book of carved pale stone pages resting on a lectern of pale wood, thin lines of morning light escaping between its pages, a sense of a season about to begin. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
home_tile_practice_tool: Painted card illustration: a quiet training yard on a stone terrace at dawn, wooden practice posts wrapped in cloth, an ash spear and a glass shield leaning on a wooden rack, soft cool morning light. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

home_tile_collection_highlight.scene: The reference sheet shows four real character models; paint ONLY their signature pieces as objects, never the characters themselves: Marund's wide round ironstone dome cap, Tunlan's very wide flat round lampshade hat with its small hanging lantern, Ervet's long translucent pale-blue glass greatsword, and Vashil's chalk ring of seven small clear glass bells. Painted card illustration: a quiet collection hall of honed chalk walls and dark ironstone arches, each piece displayed on its own low pale stone plinth or plain wooden rack (the hats resting flat on plinths, the greatsword standing on a wooden rack, the bell ring hanging from a wooden frame), warm amber lamps on the right and cool glass windows on the left. Nobody in the hall: no people, no statues, no heads, no busts, no mannequins, no armour stands, no masks. One clear focal row of pieces, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

mode_rift.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Rishal, a lean quick runner in pale grey-white armour, two hard gull-grey crest plates sweeping back from a blade-shaped glass visor, two reversed glass knives in his hands. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Vertical poster-like painting: Rishal seen from behind, small in the lower foreground on a chalk cliff edge, his gull-grey crest swept back in the wind, looking out over a colossal sundial valley seen from high above at the long hour: three carved pale roads cross the dial from left to right, deep groves of rounded broadleaf trees between them, a shallow stream along the north-south noon line, a round pale stone seat at the centre, a tall pale glass belfry on the far left rim and a low warm amber-lit ironstone dome on the far right rim, cool light on the left rim and warm light on the right rim. The roads are empty: no armies, no marching figures, no other people. A darker lower area for a title.

mode_bridge.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Ardit, a broad square knight in chalk-white and pale-blue plate, a flat-topped square helm with a narrow pale-blue glass visor band, a tall clear glass pavise shield with blue diamond studs on his left arm, a short spear; Marund, a short stout mason in a felt apron and leather, a wide round ironstone dome cap, a carved walnut mask with a carved beard and narrow carved eye slits shaded under the cap brim, a heavy stone maul. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Vertical poster-like painting: the colossal fallen stone needle of a giant sundial lying across a deep misty gorge like a bridge, one paved road along its flat top, a faintly glowing crack across its middle where Ardit (from the left, glass pavise raised) and Marund (from the right, stone maul ready) face each other, mid-size and clearly readable; a cool clear glass arch at the far left end and a warm banded ironstone lamp gate at the far right. Nobody else on the bridge. A darker lower area for a title.

mode_fray.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Rishal, a lean quick runner in pale grey-white armour, two hard gull-grey crest plates sweeping back from a blade-shaped glass visor, two reversed glass knives in his hands; Marund, a short stout mason in a felt apron and leather, a wide round ironstone dome cap, a carved walnut mask with a carved beard and narrow carved eye slits shaded under the cap brim, a heavy stone maul; Dunsom, a thin herder in a long lilac coat, a broad flat round felt hood-rim over his brow, a small carved ochre mask with a beak-like nose keel, a tall pale crook with a hanging lantern. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Vertical poster-like painting: a round honed dark basalt plate under a white noon sun with no shadows anywhere, ten small carved stone lamp posts around its rim each holding a softly tinted frosted-glass flame, a small wooden lantern cart at its centre; Rishal, Marund and Dunsom each fight for themselves across the plate, mid-size and clearly readable, a three-way duel. No other people. No symbols or markings on the plate. A darker lower area for a title.

loading_map_bridge: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: the fallen stone shaft of a giant sundial needle lying across a deep blue misty gorge, a single paved road along its top from a cool glass arch on the left to a warm banded stone gate on the right, a crack across its middle glowing faintly, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_fray: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: a round honed basalt plate set into a sunlit valley floor at noon, ten carved hour-marks around its rim, a small lantern cart at the centre, motes of light drifting down, no shadows anywhere, pale festival terraces around it, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_rift: Wide painted fantasy panorama, high aerial view: an immense circular sundial carved in pale stone fills the whole valley floor, engraved hour-lines radiating from a round stone seat at its centre and a broad engraved ring around it; three wide paved stone roads cross the dial from left to right; dense groves of round broadleaf trees fill the spaces between the roads; a hard band of violet shadow and a shallow stream cut across the dial from top to bottom; a tall pale glass belfry stands on the far left rim and a low warm amber-lit dome on the far right rim; warm late light, epic scale, ancient and monumental, no modern elements, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.

store_banner.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models in their alternate outfits, left to right: Ardit in the Chalkline outfit (ink-grey armour drawn over with white chalk line-work, flat-topped square helm with a glass visor band, clear glass pavise), Tunlan in the Noon Fair outfit (a painted paper lampshade hat in rose-lilac and chalk, a small lantern before her calm carved pale-wood mask with closed carved eyes and a gentle smile line, long lilac robe), and Ervet in the Lamplit outfit (walnut armour, a smoked amber lampresin greatsword with a small lamp cage on the pommel, full helm with a slit glass visor). Paint a NEW scene with exactly these three, on-model, as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up stiffly, and add no other people. Wide painted banner: the three pose proudly side by side on a carved sundial terrace in warm late light, strong rim light, celebratory but restrained, showing off their outfits; the left third calmer and darker for interface text.

portal_thumbnail.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Rishal, a lean quick runner in pale grey-white armour, two hard gull-grey crest plates sweeping back from a blade-shaped glass visor, two reversed glass knives in his hands; Tunlan, a tall slim woman in a long rose-and-chalk robe under a very wide flat round lampshade hat, a small lantern hanging from its front brim before her calm carved pale-wood mask (closed carved eyes, a gentle carved smile line), long jointed wooden fingers. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Game cover key art of a duel: Rishal in the left foreground on a carved sundial terrace, knives drawn, leaning into a charge toward the right; Tunlan facing him from the right, behind and above, raising her long wooden fingers in her lantern's light to cast a great curling shadow of ink smoke at him; pale glass light and ink smoke clash between them; the colossal fallen stone needle lies in the distance across a vast valley; cool morning light from the left and warm evening light from the right.
